newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: JSE adjusts indices post Rex Trueform trade.
newsitem.headline: JSE adjusts indices post Rex Trueform trade.

text.p: South Africa's Johanneburg Stock Exchange said on Monday it had readjusted indices to exclude the trade of Rex Trueform Ltd shares at a huge premium, but the deal itself was not reversed.
Syfrets Securities bought 100 Rex Trueform shares, which closed at 5.30 rand on Friday, at 184 rand in the morning.
"All the indices have been adjusted...We adjusting the deal to what the intention was. The intention was to buy at 5.30 and not at 184 rand," Michael Bastenie, equities manager, told Reuters.
The clothing index closed at 978.9 after jumping to a high of 1,324.1 after the faulty deal.
The JSE earlier said if the deal was left as it was it would distort market statistics.
